test_name: AHU shutdown and smoke damper closure on fire alarm
source_control_description_ref: control description CD-M-04 rev of record; fire matrix FM-01 line 12
preconditions: AHU-01 running in normal mode; FIP in test mode; BMS trending on
action: Trigger a detector in zone L22-Z3 at the FIP
expected_result: AHU-01 stops, smoke dampers SD-22-01/02 close, BMS shows fire mode within the stated time
tolerance: shutdown ≤ 10 s from FIP alarm; damper closed limit switch proved
record_type: witnessed test sheet + FIP event log + BMS trend export
owner: Fire contractor with MECH commissioning agent

test_name: Duty / standby pump changeover on duty failure
source_control_description_ref: control description CD-H-02; pump logic PL-CW-2
preconditions: Both pumps available; zone 2 demand simulated at 50 % of duty flow (calc H-004)
action: Isolate duty pump CW-P2A power at the local isolator
expected_result: Standby CW-P2B starts, pressure recovers, alarm 'pump fault CW-P2A' raised at BMS
tolerance: pressure dip ≤ 50 kPa; standby start ≤ 5 s; no pressure below 250 kPa at the index outlet

test_name: Mains failure — generator start and essential board transfer
source_control_description_ref: control description CD-E-01; single line diagram E-001
preconditions: Generator in auto; essential loads connected per schedule; UPS charged
action: Open the main incomer at MSB-01
expected_result: Generator starts, ATS transfers, essential board re-energised, lifts return to designated floor, fire pumps remain available
tolerance: transfer ≤ 15 s; generator frequency and voltage within the limits of the generator data sheet
record_type: witnessed test sheet + ATS event log

source_control_description_ref: control description CD-M-01; points list PL-CHW
preconditions: Chiller CH-01 running at part load; BMS alarm routing enabled
action: Raise the CHW supply set-point beyond the alarm limit or simulate the sensor value
expected_result: BMS alarm 'CHW supply high' raised and routed to the FM operator; chiller continues to run
tolerance: alarm within 60 s of the simulated condition

test_name: Fan failure mode — standby fan start and hood alarm
preconditions: Kitchen exhaust duty fan running; standby fan available
action: Stop the duty fan at the local isolator
expected_result: Standby fan starts, hood airflow proven, alarm at BMS and kitchen panel
tolerance: standby start ≤ 10 s; airflow at hood ≥ design (calc M-044)

test_name: Air balance of L22 supply terminals to design
source_control_description_ref: design air quantities schedule M-604; calc M-031
preconditions: AHU-01 at design fan speed; all dampers open; filters clean
action: Measure and adjust every L22 supply terminal
expected_result: Every terminal within tolerance of its scheduled air quantity
tolerance: ± 10 % per terminal; total within ± 5 % of the AHU design supply
record_type: balancing report with instrument serial and calibration date
